[[File:Volcanic ash detail.png|left|150px]]
'''Volcanic ash''' is obtained from mining [[ash pile]]s found around the [[Fossil Island Volcano]]. Doing so requires level 22 [[Mining]] and grants 10 experience per drop, regardless of the number of ash mined at once.

They can also be obtained as drops from various monsters on [[Fossil Island]] including [[wyvern]]s in the [[Wyvern Cave]].

==Money making==
{{Mmgsection|Mining volcanic ash}}

==Yield==
The amount of ash obtained is scaled to the player's [[Mining]] level, starting with one ash at level 22 and increasing by one for every 15 levels above 22, to a maximum of six ash at 97 (boosts can be used). [[Mining enhancers]] '''do not''' affect the yield when mining volcanic ash.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/906484443271061504|date=9 September 2017|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/107714|archivedate=25 May 2020|quote=[Do Varrock armor, mining cape and mining gloves affect mining volcanic ash?] No.}} At high Mining levels, it is possible to obtain over 6,500 ash per hour.

==Products==
{{Uses material list|Volcanic ash}}

==Uses==
Volcanic ashes are used to create a variety of farming-related items.

*Two can be used on a bucket of [[supercompost]] to create [[ultracompost]].
*25 can be used on a [[compost bin]] and 50 on a [[Big Compost Bin]], when the bins are completely filled with supercompost. This upgrades the supercompost into [[ultracompost]].
*One is used with a [[harralander potion (unf)]] to create a [[compost potion]]. This requires 22 [[Herblore]].
*If players have read the [[ash covered tome]], they can have the [[Fertile Soil]] spell treat a [[Farming/Patch locations|farming patch]] with [[ultracompost]] instead of [[supercompost]] by casting the spell while having two volcanic ash in their inventory.
